scripts.size:client: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),zlib=require('node:zlib');const dir='client/dist';const budget=Number(process.env.BUNDLE_SIZE_BUDGET_KB||650);let gz=0;const walk=(d)=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const f=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(f);else if(/\.(js|css)$/.test(e.name))gz+=zlib.gzipSync(fs.readFileSync(f)).length;}};if(!fs.existsSync(dir)){console.error('Missing '+dir+'. Run the client build first.');process.exit(1);}walk(dir);const kb=gz/1024;console.log('Client bundle (gzip): '+kb.toFixed(1)+' KiB / '+budget+' KiB budget');if(kb>budget){console.error('Bundle size budget exceeded by '+(kb-budget).toFixed(1)+' KiB');process.exit(1);}"
